claims.evidence: The witness saw the exterior, but the condition of the ports and internal dust levels are not shown.
Photo 0 only shows one black wireless controller.
Power, HDMI, and charging cables are listed as not shown in the report.
No games were shown in the photos reported by the witness.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Settings > Storage' menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, loaded, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive.

risks.risk: The console might be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controller may have 'stick drift' or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or in a controller tester.
risks.if_unproven: as a faulty controller needing replacement.

risks.risk: The console may overheat due to internal dust or dried thermal paste.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a high-performance game for 10 minutes without loud fan noise.

proof_requests: Photo of the second controller claimed by the seller.
Photos of the 10 games (discs or digital library).
Screenshot of 'System Information' showing the software version and storage capacity.
Photo of the back of the console to check the condition of the HDMI and power ports.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a TV.
response.reason: The item is confirmed as a PS4 console. It can be priced at the worst-case value for a base model with one controller and no games until further proof is provided.
